text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks for congratulating me, everyone!
Man, I'm blushing.
I've still got so much to learn, though.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
That's incredible!
Winning an award for training theory research
as a rookie!
To think they started at the same time as us...
Some people really are just special.

I'm genuinely happy for my peer's success.
There's no lie in that.
...Yet deep inside my chest,
something quietly aches.

...And so, after school on that very day,
I absentmindedly ponder while watching the
horsegirls train diligently.

I'm thoroughly mediocre.
My skills are nowhere near ready.
Under these circumstances,
taking on a trainee would be rushing
things...

—Ah, please do not lament so.
O Heavens,
what sorrow causes you to shed such cold,
bitter tears?

For a second,
I thought she was talking to me.
However, following her gaze,
I saw storm clouds drifting across the
sky...
(RUMBLE, RUMBLE... KRAAA-BOOOOOM!!)

Even blades of lightning...!
To strike the moment I appeared... Ha!

Could this too be a trial bestowed upon the
Saint...!?
Aaaahhh......!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
Isn't the lightning getting closer and closer?
So scary!
Everyone! The instructor says, 'It's dangerous,
evacuate to the gym~'!
choice_data_list: Ah, excuse me! You need to evacuat...
Ah, excuse me! You need to evacuat...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
That lightning is crazy. Spooky...
Aww, and I really wanted to run outside
today~

Everyone, please lift your heads.
I shall appease the heavens through the
power of holy prayer.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Leave this to me, Saint Red Desire...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Now, I shall open the window.
Please stand back, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
O Heavens, O Earth,
O omnipresent spirits of 'that land'...
Grant the power of mana unto my prayer—!
(WHOOOOOOSH! RUMBLE-CRASH-BOOM!)

—It wasn't! After a momentary lull,
a driving sideways rain battered the windows,
rattling them violently!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Aaaahh...! How utterly malevolent!
Ngh... For now,
it seems we have no choice but to endure.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhh! Are you okay!?
You're completely soaked!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
What a kind soul you are.
However, I shall be fine.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: For I am... a saint!

—Ever since that encounter,
Red Desire started catching my eye all around
campus.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah! My shoelace, it snapped...!
Now I cannot sprint to class. Kh,
another trial set before me...!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
I am so so sorry!
My hand slipped while carrying the cleaning
water...!
I had no idea anyone was standing down
there...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it. This, too,
is a trial for a saint.
Mere water cannot extinguish these holy
crimson flames.

A few days later,
Red Desire took part in a mock race.
A wildly popular star prospect had entered
as well...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Let's all have a good race today, okay?
I'll do my best to make sure it's a great
one!

Her name was Buena Vista.
Already regarded as the top favorite
for next year's Triple Tiara path,
she was the candidate for next "heroine."

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
Well,
she's definitely winning.
She's on a totally different level.
She really has that special aura! Ugh,
can I even keep up?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Buena-san,
I am grateful for the chance to test myself
against you.
I, the Saint Red Desire,
vow to give you my absolute all...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Desire-chan!
The feeling's mutual. I won't lose either!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Indeed...
I swear that I shall overcome the trial that
is you...!

Does she possess incredible confidence?
...And then, the late stretch.
Red Desire held a solid position as they
entered the final straightaway!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ngh—!
O destiny, grant me passage like this...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Now's my chance! Hah...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Kh...! Not yet...!
Haaaaahhhhh---!

Red Desire held on against Buena Vista's
staggering late surge.
Her running demonstrated unmistakable talent,
almost divinely inspired—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
That's our Buena-chaaan! I knew you'd win!
You really are a genius!

—Yet, she couldn't pull off the win.
Praise for Buena Vista echoed across the
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Haah... haah...
Once more, I fell just short...

She had challenged her with so much
confidence.
One would expect even Red Desire to feel
dejected, but...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent, Buena-san.
The wall you represent grows endlessly higher,
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And yet, I know...
Trials only present themselves to those
capable of overcoming them.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—I will not lose next time.
After all, I am a saint.

—Even after night fell,
I couldn't get the look in her eyes out of
my head.
She stays undeterred because she's a 'saint,'
but...
choice_data_list: I used to have a phase like that t...
I used to have a phase like that t...

text_block_list.text:
That adolescent feeling of believing you're
'special'...
It brought back a nostalgic,
slightly embarrassing warmth.

Still,
holding onto that belief must be what drives
her to work so hard.
...She's an intriguing girl.
If given the chance,
I wanted to talk to her.
